items.title: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes
items.excerpt: Netflix developed Quasar, an internal tool that combines semantic code indexing and API comparisons to identify downstream consumers affected by library changes. Netflix is also exploring agent-assisted consumer migrations. By Leela Kumili
